messages:
Marcus Chen: Heads-up: Candidate Evan Cho (Senior Infra Eng) scheduled onsite Mon 2025-05-12. Train into Union Station 08:40, interview loop 10:00-13:00. Candidate requests ASL interpreter (in-person preferred) and a low-sensory waiting space. Also needs hotel night if return train departs after 21:00. Who owns interpreter + hotel?
Nina Gomez: I can coordinate interpreter + hotel booking. Our standard hotel cap is $200/night. Marcus, can you confirm any mobility/access needs (room floor, elevator)?
Marcus Chen: Evan noted back pain and prefers ground or elevator-accessible room. I'll DM phone + dietary notes (no shellfish).
Priya Shah: I'm on the panel starting 10:00. If interpreter joins, do we set AV differently? We might need a TV placed so interpreter can see the conversation comfortably. @FacilitiesBot?
FacilitiesBot: Auto-response: ASL interpreter request logged. AV options: TV with HDMI or Zoom room available in Conf Rm B. Low-sensory room reserved: Conf Rm E (09:15-09:55). Visitor badge scheduled (09:00-10:30 pickup).
Marcus Chen: Thanks. I'll add a 20-30min prep buffer for Evan with the interpreter (09:30-09:55).
Nina Gomez: Travel/hotel plan: TravelOps, please place a company booking on hold at an accessible room. If candidate prefers to book and request reimbursement, we need original receipt + Concur claim. Marcus, please confirm candidate preference.
TravelOpsBot: Auto-response: Hotel hold placed at Redwood Inn (standard king, ground-floor request noted) pending candidate confirmation. Interpreter vendor contacted. Tentative booking ID: TRV-8821.
Marcus Chen: Evan prefers company-booked hotel. I shared candidate contact; TravelOps please confirm. Also arranged Lyft voucher for arrival from station — I'll DM the code to the candidate and ops.
Priya Shah: Quick scheduling note: Jordan can cover 11:00-11:30 if I need to step out. Jordan, confirm?
Jordan Lee: I can take 11:00-11:30. Will be onsite.
Marcus Chen: Draft calendar details for invite (will paste into invite):
```
Subject: Redwood Onsite Interview — Evan Cho
When: Mon May 12, 2025
Arrival/Prep: 09:15 (conf Rm E low-sensory prep with interpreter 09:30-09:55)
Interviews: 10:00 — 13:00 (Conf Rm B, TV for interpreter + Zoom fallback)
Location: Redwood HQ — 2nd floor Conf Rm B
Interpreter: ASL interpreter booked in-person (TRV-8821)
Reception badge pickup: 09:00-10:30
Hotel: Redwood Inn (company hold) — ground-floor requested
Reimbursement: If candidate books, submit receipt + Concur. Otherwise company pays direct.
Point of contact: Marcus Chen (ext 4410)
Zoom fallback: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/xxxx
```
Nina Gomez: Please add: "Interpreter will join candidate during prep and will stay for full loop" and note low-sensory seating near room entrance.
Marcus Chen: Added. Facilities: can you confirm TV + HDMI + spare mic for conf room? Also need a second chair near the entrance for interpreter.
FacilitiesBot: Noted. TV + HDMI dongle + mic set up in Conf Rm B by 08:30. Extra chair staged by entrance. Low-sensory room Conf Rm E prepared with dim lighting.
TravelOpsBot: Interpreter fully confirmed (vendor: SignRight) for 09:30-13:30. Hotel hold confirmed; TravelOps will finalize once candidate confirms. Booking contact (internal): travel@redwood.com.
Nina Gomez: Expense policy reminder: hotel and interpreter vendor billed direct to company when booked by TravelOps. If candidate pays taxi/ride and seeks reimbursement, limit $50 without pre-approval. Anything above needs prior sign-off from People Ops.
Marcus Chen: Candidate confirmed company booking preference and acceptance of hotel. I'll finalize invites + send reception instructions and the Lyft code via DM.
Priya Shah: One more: please include a short note in the invite about meeting interpreter and any confidentiality/privacy preferences.
Marcus Chen: Will do. Final check: action owners: Nina — interpreter/hotel oversight, TravelOpsBot — vendor + booking, FacilitiesBot — rooms/AV/chairs, Marcus — candidate comms + calendar. Flag issues by EOD 2025-05-06.
Jordan Lee: All set from my side.
Nina Gomez: Thanks everyone. TravelOpsBot will post a reminder on 2025-05-11 08:00 with hotel confirmation + interpreter contact details.
TravelOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 2025-05-11 08:00 — send hotel confirmation & interpreter contact to Marcus and People Ops.
